messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Changes in appetite and a feeling of fullness with fewer cravings occur during this time.
Then, more measurable weight loss occurs in the first 2 to 3 months.

To learn more, see ” How long does it take for Zepbound to work?"

The relation 'has weight loss timeline' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has a specific timeline for weight loss effects as described by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'alters absorption of': The subject drug changes the way the object entity is absorbed in the body.
B. 'has weight loss results by dose': The subject study provided weight loss results for the treatment dose specified by the object entity.
C. 'has dose availability': The subject drug is available in the specific dose or dosage options indicated by the object entity.
